name: plan-compliance-validator
description: Validate implementation compliance against plan contracts using git diff and deterministic checks.

interface.shortDescription: Validate code changes against a locked implementation plan.
interface.longDescription: Runs deterministic checks from plan contract files and git diff to ensure implementation scope, terms, tests, and handoff completeness.
defaultPrompt: Run plan compliance validation for BOA-191 against main...HEAD and return JSON.
Validate if changed files stay within the contract scope and list violations.
Check handoff and tests against plan contract before final delivery.
